title: Pleasure Island Parasail at Sportsman Marina

services.name: Parasailing at Sportsman Marina
services.desc: Best Views of Orange Beach! All Ages Welcome! On the boat for about an hour About Our trained and professional staff look forward to providing you with a fun and safe experience! You will take off and land gently right on the back of our boat, so there is no need to get wet. If you want to hop in the water, you are more than welcome to take a dip in the emerald green waters. Please dress comfortably and wear sunscreen. We recommend applying it ahead of time so that you can relax once you are on the boat. We are conveniently located at Sportman Marina, right next to the Tiki Bar, 1 Hour • All Ages Welcome • Best Views of Orange Beach!

blurb: Guests soar high above the Alabama Gulf Coast on a parasailing boat, taking off and landing gently on the back of the boat without getting wet. They enjoy breathtaking views of turquoise waters, sugar-white sand beaches, and can spot dolphins and other marine life. The experience is family and group friendly, with one hour trips available.
